d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how hundreds of flights across the US were grounded for up to five hours on Friday in the longest nationwide air traffic shutdown since the 9/11 attacks, throwing travel across the country into chaos ahead of the Thanksgiving rush. Nearly 6,000 flights were cancelled and over 800 diverted, stranding more than a million passengers, sports teams, and cargo shipments.
